theorems.statement: ∀ (n N N' : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (f : Rn N → Rn N') (B : Set (Rn N)), Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 1 M V W ψ → (∀ x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap) → MeasurableSet B → B ⊆ W ∩ M → (∀ y ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ f y) → (∀ y ∈ B, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ f y)) → InjOn f B → μHE[n] (f '' B) = ∫⁻ y in B, ENNReal.ofReal (areaJacobian ((fderiv ℝ f y).comp (tangentSpace M y).subtypeL)) ∂μHE[n]
